question: A, B, C, D, E and F live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on, till the topmost floor is numbered 6. D lives on an odd numbered floor but not 5. The sum of floors on which D and A live is 5. Only 3 people live between A and F. B lives immediately above E. How many people live above B?

1) D lives on an odd numbered floor but not 5.
